snippet.title: Chris's Classroom V1.3 - New speedrun toggle + updates!
snippet.description:
Chris's Classroom is closing in on completion, and the last touches are being added to the game!

↓↓↓ Update V1.3 Log ↓↓↓

- Added a Speedrun Timer toggle in the settings, and a speedrun timer! You can now track how fast you beat Classic Mode or Super Hard Mode.
- Fixed Classic Mode detention UI for the speedrun timer (this'll apply for Super Hard Mode too).
- Added vents to Super Hard Mode for a future character...
- Added another easter egg
- Added a Debug Mode for hidden scenes, easter eggs, and more
- Added a Version text
- Updated Super Hard Mode soundtracks

Engine used: Unity 2022.3.62f1
Almost all assets in the game are created by me!
